quiet: Draw a picture of your house and colour it in carefully.
The cube of sugar dissolved slowly in the hot tea.
Let the children choose a book from the shelf.
The two friends met at the café near the station.
Join the club to get a discount on every purchase.

The distance from the hotel to the beach is short.
The rectangle of lawn behind the school needs mowing.
